last_session.text: The party caught the Clurichen Naggeneen in the Golden Egg's basement and handed him to Quinn. Quinn hung him in a bag behind his bar.
Trout recruited the newly arrived halfling Squints as a junior assistant in his Halfling Corps.
Dunk spotted a glowing magical mithril chain shirt in Warwick the smith's shop and planned to get it.
Dunk traded for faun wine at the Faun Grove and gave Ingrid a watered-down batch for her sleeping potion.
One-armed survivor George told the party where the black dragon's lair is and how it killed his companions.
Father William marked Brandon's Barrow Mound on the party's map, and the party set out for it.
The party rescued Brother Dirk from a man-eating giant's cottage and outran the giant.

open.text: Find the treasure marked on the party's treasure map.
Kill the black dragon and drag its body into town to collect Eric the Reeve's 1000 gold.
Get the magical mithril chain shirt from Warwick the smith's shop.
George says nothing pierces the black dragon's scales. His companions' arrows and swords all failed.
If Dunk helps Ingrid give Warwick her sleeping potion tonight, he can enter the shop for the mithril shirt while the smith sleeps. The potion isn't made yet, and Dunk heavily diluted the faun wine.
Father William says that if the party retrieves the magic sword from Brandon's Barrow Mound, they can kill the black dragon. George says no one knows if the legend is true.
If the party returns to the Clumsy Fox and hires Lady Hilda, the seasoned warrior will join them against the dragon.
If the party pays Drop Dead Ned 100 gold for the week, he and his killer wasp will do anything as long as he gets to kill people. He gives back 5 gold for each permitted kill.
What has become of the shipments to Brandonsford?
Who is Vivian the witch, and does she share a coven with Ingrid?
Dr. Uriah must do penance at Brandon's Barrow Mound, as he promised Father William.
Dr. Uriah must donate 10 gold for the Barrow Mound's upkeep, as he promised Father William.
Dunk must help Ingrid into Warwick's house and give Warwick the sleeping potion once she has made it.
Trout and the party owe Squints second pick of the first treasure, after the elite members. Until then, Squints pays for himself and his gear.
Sir Phidipaldi must bring his lance against the dragon, as he vowed to George.
The black dragon has a fatally poisonous bite and spits sulfur. George says it can't fly yet but soon will, and then the town is doomed.
A man-eating giant lives in a huge stone cottage on the party's route north and may seize travelers who pass.
